# waroom_user (Data Source)

Retrieves information about a Waroom user. Look the user up by exactly one of `sub`, `nickname` or `slack_user_key`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up a user by nickname.
data "waroom_user" "by_nickname" {
  nickname = "alice"
}

# Look up a user by the ID of the linked Slack user.
data "waroom_user" "by_slack_user" {
  slack_user_key = "U0123ABCD"
}

# Look up a user by sub.
data "waroom_user" "by_sub" {
  sub = "auth0|abc123"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `nickname` (String) The user's nickname. Nicknames are unique in an organization.
- `slack_user_key` (String) The ID of the Slack user linked to the user (e.g. `U0123ABCD`). Null when the user is not linked to Slack.
- `sub` (String) The user's subject identifier (e.g. `auth0|abc123`), which identifies a user in Waroom.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) The time the user was created, in RFC 3339 format.
- `id` (String) User ID. This is an alias for `sub`.
- `phone_verified` (Boolean) Whether the user's phone number is verified. Only verified users can be added to on-call rotations.
- `picture` (String) The URL of the user's profile picture.
- `status` (String) The user's status: `active`, `inactive`, `invited`, `invitation_pending`, `invitation_failed` or `deactivated`.
